0.text: It began with a tree, a maple tree. As you left its comforting embrace, you sensed that an adventure beyond your wildest dreams loomed ahead. A Maple Leaf brushed your shoes, and you tucked it into your Explorer Book as a reminder of your origins.

1.text: And so, your adventure began.

0.text: While exploring Victoria Island, you bumped into a girl named Sugar.

1.text: She was headed for Ellinia to take her Job Advancement test, but her fear of bugs got in her way.

2.text: You took care of the bugs with ease, but Sugar had a new problem: she said the tree was crying out in pain. And so, you brought medicine for the tree.

3.text: You couldn't help but wonder. Sugar was scared of bugs and could hear trees. Was she really suited to be an Explorer?

4.text: Sugar admitted to sharing your doubts, but she said she had no choice but to keep moving forward, for she had to stop the disaster that was headed toward Maple World...

0.text: Just as you were settling down, you heard a news flash. An important jewel from the Explorer's Guild was stolen!

1.text: Athena Pierce requested your help in retrieving it, which is how you ended up chasing the thief up and down the outskirts of Henesys. When you finally stopped the thief and got the jewel, an Explorer named Olive appeared.

2.text: Olive said she was the one who was supposed to deliver the jewel to Athena Pierce in the first place and that she wanted to finish her delivery.

3.text: Olive laughed when you handed her the jewel, which gave you a bad feeling. So you were hardly surprised when Athena Pierce told you that Olive never showed up.

4.text: Athena Pierce also revealed that the jewel was actually a Seal Stone, an artifact of immense but mysterious powers. Who stole the Seal Stone? What evil plans were they hatching upon Maple World? And none of this was your fault, was it?

0.text: You traveled to Ereve in search of Olive and the Seal Stone.

1.text: When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

2.text: You thought maybe she was telling the truth, but before you could decide, someone from the Thieves Guild arrived and snatched Olive away.

3.text: As she was being dragged off, Olive begged you to talk to Neinheart in Ereve to find proof of her innocence.

4.text: Neinheart confirmed that the 'Master of Disguise' did in fact exist and that his disguises were flawless.

5.text: But now you wondered, who in Maple World was this so-called Master of Disguise?

0.text: With your latest lead, you finally felt like you were putting together the pieces to the puzzle.

1.text: Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

2.text: While there, Rondo overheard some Black Wings saying that their leaders were collecting Seal Stones, though they weren't sure why.

3.text: With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

4.text: Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

5.text: What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

6.text: And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?

0.text: You checked on various towns to make sure Maple World was prepared for the Black Mage's potential return, and in the process, discovered that the Gate of the Present was open.

1.text: You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

2.text: Using the Seal Stone Athena Pierce had in her possession to replace the broken seal might stop the Black Mage from breaking free, or so you hoped.

3.text: But as you were installing the Seal Stone, an unfamiliar voice spoke, sending chills tingling down your spine.

4.text: #e'Do not be a fool. Give in to the darkness.'#n

5.text: You continued your mission, despite your fears, but just as you were screwing in the final bolt, the seal broke. A dark voice reverberated, then grew faint.

6.text: #e'You will pay for your foolishness...'#n

0.text: Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

1.text: Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

2.text: It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

3.text: As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

4.text: There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.

0.text: You were assigned to speak to Aran, so you visited Rien Island, where Lilin peppered you with questions, testing your intentions.

1.text: In the midst of Lilin's quizzes, Aran appeared. But he had amnesia and could remember nothing of use.

2.text: He showed you a Seal Stone, and together, you pieced together that each continent had its own stone, specific to it. Unfortunately, many of those stones were in the hands of the Black Wings.

3.text: Aran promised he'd be around if you ever needed him, and you returned to Maple Island.

4.text: When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

5.text: #eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n

0.text: Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

1.text: As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by  brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

2.text: It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

3.text: His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

4.text: ...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

5.text: The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

6.text: Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.

0.text: Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

1.text: Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

2.text: You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

3.text: The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

4.text: She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

5.text: She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

6.text: Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

7.text: Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

8.text: And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.

3.text: With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

4.text: Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

5.text: What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

6.text: And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?

0.text: You checked on various towns to make sure Maple World was prepared for the Black Mage's potential return, and in the process, discovered that the Gate of the Present was open.

1.text: You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

2.text: Using the Seal Stone Athena Pierce had in her possession to replace the broken seal might stop the Black Mage from breaking free, or so you hoped.

3.text: But as you were installing the Seal Stone, an unfamiliar voice spoke, sending chills tingling down your spine.

4.text: #e'Do not be a fool. Give in to the darkness.'#n

5.text: You continued your mission, despite your fears, but just as you were screwing in the final bolt, the seal broke. A dark voice reverberated, then grew faint.

6.text: #e'You will pay for your foolishness...'#n

0.text: Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

1.text: Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

2.text: It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

3.text: As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

4.text: There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.

0.text: You were assigned to find Luminous, so you headed for the Forest Edge around Ellinia to search for him.

1.text: You stumbled upon a robot, which seemed out of place. It called you an intruder, so you fought it, thinking it had to be evil.

2.text: Luminous, the Magician of Light, showed up just as you defeated the robot, which turned out not to be an enemy after all.

3.text: After you calmed him down, Luminous revealed that Seal Stones were created to seal the Black Mage away, but that this method wouldn't work a second time. He couldn't help you further.

4.text: You parted with Luminous to return to Maple Island.

5.text: When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

6.text: #eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n

0.text: Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

1.text: As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by  brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

2.text: It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

3.text: His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

4.text: ...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

5.text: The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

6.text: Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.

0.text: Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

1.text: Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

2.text: You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

3.text: The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

4.text: She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

5.text: She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

6.text: Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

7.text: Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

8.text: And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.
